title: SiO₂ Glass via Melt-Quench
description: Minimal workflow for producing a silica glass structure from a multi-stage melt-quench simulation using amorphouspy and LAMMPS with the SHIK interatomic potential.
publications: Sundararaman, S., Huang, L., Ispas, S., & Kob, W. (2018). New interaction potentials for alkali and alkaline-earth aluminosilicate glasses. Journal of Chemical Physics, 148(19), 194504.
Sundararaman, S., Huang, L., Ispas, S., & Kob, W. (2019). New interaction potentials for borate glasses with mixed network formers. Journal of Chemical Physics, 150(15), 154505.
Plimpton, S. (1995). Fast parallel algorithms for short-range molecular dynamics. Journal of Computational Physics, 117(1), 1-19.
